description: Removes the Popular LIVEs recommendation card and live stream broadcasts from the search discovery page.
name: Hide Popular Lives In Search

description: Filters videos disclosing branded/paid-promotional content (Contenido Promocional tag) from For You, Following and Friends feeds.
name: Hide Promotional Content

description: Filters previously watched videos from incoming For You feed batches.
name: Hide Seen Videos

description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile headers and inbox surfaces.
name: Hide Suggested Accounts

description: Removes the suggested search keywords section ('You may like' / 'Search suggestions') from the search discovery page.
name: Hide Suggested Searches

description: Removes product showcase badges, shopping cart tags, and the TikTok Shop / Mall tab from navigation bars and video posts.
name: Hide TikTok Shop & Mall

options.title: Hide Shop Navigation Tab

options.description: Removes shopping cart tags, product showcase badges, and commercial anchors from FYP and Following feed videos.
options.title: Hide Video Product Anchors
